brute_force.title: Brute-force authentication attack
brute_force.remediation: Enforce MFA, account lockout and rate limiting; block the source IP; reset credentials of targeted accounts, especially if a login succeeded.

port_scan.title: Network reconnaissance (port scan)
port_scan.nist_csf: DE.CM-01 (Networks are monitored to find adverse events)
port_scan.iso_27001: A.8.16 Monitoring activities; A.8.20 Networks security
port_scan.remediation: Block the scanning IP at the firewall, close unused ports, and add IDS rules for scan detection.

data_exfiltration.title: Suspected data exfiltration
data_exfiltration.nist_csf: PR.DS-01 (Confidentiality of data-at-rest is protected); DE.AE-02 (Adverse events are analyzed)
data_exfiltration.remediation: Cut the outbound connection, identify what data left, restrict egress traffic, and start the breach-notification assessment.

multi_stage_intrusion.title: Multi-stage intrusion (access, escalation, exfiltration)
multi_stage_intrusion.nist_csf: PR.AA-05 (Access permissions follow least privilege); RS.AN-03 (Incident analysis)
multi_stage_intrusion.iso_27001: A.8.2 Privileged access rights; A.5.26 Response to information security incidents
multi_stage_intrusion.remediation: Isolate the host, revoke and rotate privileged credentials, run forensics on the full attack chain, and invoke the incident response plan.

low_confidence_anomaly.title: Low-confidence anomaly (possible false positive)
low_confidence_anomaly.iso_27001: A.5.25 Assessment of information security events
low_confidence_anomaly.remediation: Analyst review. If benign, record it as a false positive and use it to tune the model.
